data.narrative:
Mbodi AI is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Xavier Chi and Sebastian Peralta, having raised $4.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (277810.KQ) in the robotics and manufacturing sector, though the immediate peer set at identical or adjacent stages remains limited.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is reliably applicable. Using total raised ($4.4M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $11M. A peer-median approach could not be supported: while 11 same-sector robotics peers exist, insufficient overlap in stage, timing, and valuation tier (fewer than 3 datapoints meeting narrow filters) makes direct median comparison misleading. Relying on all-sector medians would introduce excessive noise.

The triangulated range supported by this analysis spans $9M to $13M, with $11M as the median point. This range reflects the single applicable method and should be treated with appropriate caution. Key uncertainties include the nascent state of the seed-stage robotics financing market, which limits statistically robust peer anchoring, and the absence of revenue or operational metrics that might refine stage-progression multiples. Investors should supplement this valuation with detailed due diligence on team, technical differentiation, and path to Series A.
